detail.longDescription: 🤖 Fake "security tools" on GitHub are backdooring infosec pros. Dr. Web counts 2,000+ Windows hosts hit: malicious VS project files and Python/Go scripts, a pre-build event firing the chain, then an Electron loader (Microsoft.exe) that patches AMSI/ETW and injects AsyncRAT, a clipper and an infostealer. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/fake-security-tools-on-github-push-backdoors-and-infostealers/ # Malware # InfoSec # GitHub
